message:
Ah, the joys of a sudden power outage! I remember one evening when the lights went out just as I was settling in with a good book. My friend Lily, bless her heart, immediately started panicking about everything: the food in the fridge, her phone battery, and even her beloved houseplants. 

I calmly pulled out my trusty flashlight and found the power bank I always keep charged for moments like this. We ended up having a cozy evening with snacks, a little laughter, and a lot of flashlight games. 

The takeaway? A little preparedness goes a long way in keeping the calm when the lights go out. How do you stay comfortable during a blackout? I’d love to hear your tips! 😊
